title: Pipeline: composition, assumptions, quotient
shows: Composing component contracts, fixing a failed refinement of the assumptions, guarding against vacuity, and computing the contract of a missing component.

steps.note: The contracts are connected through alarm, an output of Sensor and an input of Brake.
Trace: the obstacle goes away, as Car assumes, but the alarm stays on forever, which breaks the assumption G F !alarm of Brake. The sensor guarantee is too weak.
Fixed sensor: the alarm is on exactly when there is an obstacle.
The assumptions of the composite can be satisfied: the refinement does not hold vacuously.
The largest contract that, composed with the sensor, refines Car. Its output is stop; obstacle and alarm are inputs.
Brake is a valid implementation of the missing component.
